title: The Wait
tagline: sDAI yield for waiting times between stages in public goods funding rounds
description:
This project increases available funds from public goods funding rounds by using sDAI deposits to generate yield during verification stages or waiting times before distribution. 

This enables donors to increase their impact and lets boosters support the round by sharing the yield of funds that can be retrieved after distribution.
how_its_made: This project uses Spark SDAI ERC-4626 contract as a yield-bearing token, a custom safe contract to manage the deposited funds and a states contract representing verification or governance stages before distribution
